  ) AS deficient_days

       na.notice_id AS first_notice, nb.notice_id AS second_notice
FROM stock_lot AS a

JOIN supplier_notice AS na ON na.supplier_id = a.supplier_id

WITH daily AS (
  SELECT item_code, COUNT(CASE WHEN closing_units < 5 THEN 1 END) OVER (
    PARTITION BY item_code ORDER BY day_no ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW
  ) AS deficient_days
  FROM stock_day
)
SELECT item_code, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE deficient_days = 3) AS charged_days,
       70 * COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE deficient_days = 3) AS penalty_cents
FROM daily
GROUP BY item_code
ORDER BY item_code COLLATE BINARY
